notes.title: Regarding recent crashes
notes.content:
Have you been getting crashes after the last update?[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39552646/c3e95e550fcb47ace5b2c12e83a1c1d3be284406.png"]
It's most likely because you don't have the most recent "Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable" installed.

From now on, VTube Studio will automatically install it when updating.  

But if you are getting crashes right now, please install it manually for now:

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist?view=msvc-170

Make sure you get the X64 version from this page.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39552646/323d017dce769115a9992a600f3c973acca822a0.png"]


Here is a direct link to the currently most recent version: https://download.visualstudio.microsoft.com/download/pr/7ebf5fdb-36dc-4145-b0a0-90d3d5990a61/CC0FF0EB1DC3F5188AE6300FAEF32BF5BEEBA4BDD6E8E445A9184072096B713B/VC_redist.x64.exe



After downloading and installing, VTube Studio should work again. Sorry for the inconvenience!!

If you still have any crashes after this, please report them on Discord:

Join VTS Discord

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.32.0
notes.content:
This update adds a lot of changes for Live2D items and the VNet collab feature.


The first big new feature is Split Live2D items!! You can have split Live2D items now with a front and back part, so they're wrapping around the main model and make it look like you're really wearing the item.



Internally this works by splitting the Live2D item at a certain layer into a front/back part and then setting orders within the main model for those parts separately.



VTube Studio comes with a few items that already have this set up so you can play around with them. But, you can also easily set this up for your own Live2D items.



More info: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Between-Layer-Item-Pinning



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39552646/1a489a4c834c3b27f8dd7ce489d4668df9e42fb1.gif"]

Isn't that cool!?



Next, you can now pin stuff to other people during collabs or take their items now. This also works with the split Live2D items. Not much else to explain here. People requested this one a lot!



More info: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Multiplayer



[img src="https://i.imgur.com/sG59L4s.gif"]

Also, there are new expression parameter modes! When you create an expression, you can now select between "overwrite" (standard), "add" and "multiply".



"Add" just adds a static value to that parameter at the end (after tracking) and "Multiply" multiplies the Live2D parameter by the set value. The value can also be negative, so you can do a lot of interesting stuff with it, like having hotkeys that invert the tracking.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39552646/2ab906caaea06eb18b61a71d02ed33cd41e19995.gif"]

Oh and there's mocopi tracking in VTube Studio now!!??! It's a bit crazy to use that in 2D models, but the Sony mocopi team reached out and asked if it could be added. They even made a really pretty example model you can use for free.



For more info on that, check this page: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/mocopi



There's even more stuff:



 You can now turn expressions on/off WITHOUT making hotkeys for them.

 You can now create expressions and expression hotkeys for items super easily.

 You can now set ArtMesh recolors for items directly.

 You can set fixed positions for VNet collab participants (who's in front).

 VNet collab guest model positions will now be remembered when guests leave and re-join (if you control their positions).

 There's now detailed upload/download statistics so you can see how far along VNet model upload/downloads are (can sometimes be useful when models take long to upload).

 "Alt" is supported as a hotkey now.

 You can now turn on pin notifications that show you exactly which layer in your model items pin to.

 You can set items to only pin to one specific layer in your model. Useful to actually get those hats to pin to your head and not some weird hair overlay layer (though that can look pretty funny too).



And then there's some more stuff and a bunch of bugfixes.



Finally, there were some adjustments that had to be made to the watermark in VTube Studio so the app stays compliant with the updated Live2D SDK licensing terms. For more information, please check this Tweet: https://x.com/VTubeStudio/status/1930366944441511953



Sorry for the inconvenience.



For a full list of changes, see: https://trello.com/c/l6FuhwFf

And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.31.2
notes.content:
This update adds the new version of the NVIDIA RTX Tracker. This version implements the following changes:


 Better tracking for eye-related parameters (eye movement and winking in particular).
 Better performance, responsiveness and expressiveness in general.
 Restores compatibility with new NVIDIA RTX 50-series GPUs.
 Finetuning for blendshape calibration. For more info: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/NVIDIA-Webcam-Tracker#finetuning-and-calibration
 Can also be used with VBridger with all included blendshapes.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39552646/7c766976a7dc280c797937af5694b8006f609913.gif

Also, you can now configure zoom/rotation speed when scrolling and choose between two zoom/rotate settings:


 Zoom/Rotate around Live2D model center.
 Zoom/Rotate around mouse cursor (NEW).

Zooming towards the mouse cursor should feel more natural, so in a future update that may be set as the default for new users.

The zoom/rotation settings can be found here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39552646/b2c743a875e0d01e8b26aff4fbf6e9c2e41f659e.png

The following small changes/bugfixes were also implemented:


 Warning popup before deleting parameter mappings and hotkeys to prevent deletion by accident.
 VNet: Warning popup when upload fails because file path is too long for at least one file.

For a full list, see: Trello: https://trello.com/c/pHPHtAXU


And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.29.0
notes.content:
This update adds Web-Items to VTube Studio.

A Web-Item is essentially a full web browser, available as an item in VTube Studio. They can be moved, rotated and pinned like normal items but display a website that you can interact with. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39552646/a789a658afdeb5e7f260c14ccf58a6f17815eacf.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39552646/c17890d48a5975ed0e25dd6f47380cb0fde0ac03.gif

Web Items are basically like "OBS Browser Sources", just directly in VTube Studio.

You can use them to display and pin pretty much anything you want directly in VTube Studio... donation goal trackers, chat boxes, videos, any other fancy stream widgets... the possibilities are endless!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39552646/aecc564940c898bb48a93ad1e4f2e1f604e8ba6a.png

For more info, check out this page: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Web-Items

The following features, bugfixes and improvements were also implemented:


 Support for the Live2D Cubism Editor API. This allows VTube Studio to directly send tracking data into the Live2D Cubism Editor. This makes it much easier for model riggers to test physics setups without repeatedly exporting the model.
 Added tooltips to some of the main menu options and config options. Tooltip coverage will be expanded in the future to hopefully make the UI a little less confusing.
 Fix for issue where VTS watermark would show up even when DLC was purchased.
 API: New API for controlling post-processing effects.
 Emote-Dropper: Support for renamed emotes.
 Many smaller bugfixes.


For a full list including all bugfixes, see here: https://trello.com/c/I3ie1YiP


For more info, check the API documentation: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio


And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the VTube Studio Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.content:

And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.28.0 - Post Processing Effects / VFX
notes.content:
This update adds built-in post processing to VTube Studio, including effects such as bloom, backlight, lens-distortion and many more!!!

You can create effect presets and switch between them using visual effect hotkeys. It's a lot of fun, please give it a try!! (some examples below)

For more info, check out this page: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Visual-Effects

Other stuff that was added:

 Post-processing (see above)
 Spout2 Background, a special background that accepts Spout2 video streams and puts them as background in VTube Studio. Windows only. Be careful not to show any personal info if you use this!!
 VNet: File upload/download rate limiting. With this, you can set upload/download speed limits to make sure big/long uploads don’t lag your VNet connection (or in the worst case break it entirely). Useful for users with low-bandwidth internet connections.
 WebP "support". When you drag in WebP images (.webp) or put them in the “Items” folder, they are automatically converted to .png so they can be loaded in VTube Studio. WebP HATE!!!!!
 API:  You can now load arbitrary data as item (JPG/PNG) using the ItemLoadRequest after getting special permissions from the user. Also, you can now use the API to pin items to the model and get notified when the model or items were clicked. For more info, check the API documentation: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio 


More info on Spout2 Background can be found here: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Spout2-Background

The following bugfixes and improvements were also implemented:

 Monthly backup warning. A popup is shown once a month to remind you to backup your models. Seriously, do it.
 Fixed bug that made 7TV emotes not work in emote dropper and Twitch chat scroll.
 Temporarily force VTube Studio to always start in fullscreen mode on macOS 14.2 because there is currently a macOS bug that makes VTS not register clicks in window mode on that new macOS version.


For a full list, see: https://trello.com/c/SxKckubK 

And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.26.6
notes.content:
This update implements the following changes:


 New webcam face tracker: Google Mediapipe. Comparable quality to NVIDIA tracker but no special GPU needed and works with hand tracking too. WINDOWS ONLY for now.
 Added opacity to Screen/Multiply ArtMesh Color presets. Works with hotkeys as well and is compatible with VNet.
 VNet: Auto-retry for all uploads/downloads. If any upload/download fails for models or items, it is now retried until it succeeds. This fixes a bug where sometimes models would not load for collab participants.
 VNet: Increased maximum session time limit: One VNet session can now be up to 45 hours before it has to be restarted.
 VNet: Increased model file size limits. One model can now be up to 250 MB total (compressed) with a single-file-limit of 95 MB. The maximum file count per model is now 250, increased from 150.
 Android/iOS: You can now permanently turn off the “on-screen hotkeys” (white circles) on mobile when no model is loaded. To do that, make sure no model is loaded and check the “hotkeys” settings tab.


For more info on how to set up and use the new Google Mediapipe tracker, see here: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Mediapipe-Webcam-Tracker

The following minor changes/improvements were also made:


 Android: Fixed bug where models were always rendered solid black on some devices including the Samsung S23.
 Re-enabled automatic GPU priority setting since the bug that caused crashes has been fixed.
 Models can no longer be loaded when they’re directly in the “Live2DModels” folder. This now shows a warning instead. A model should ALWAYS be in an own subfolder in the “Live2DModels” folder, something like “Live2DModels/MyCoolModel”
 ...and a few more minor bugfixes.



For a full list, see: https://trello.com/c/dmgd8zGX
And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VNet - VTube Studio Multiplayer Collab
notes.content:
This update adds the VNet DLC:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384550/

VNet is VTube Studio's built-in online multiplayer collab system.


 Supports 4-people collabs with your Steam friends.
 You can use items, Live2D items, and much more...
 Everything is automatically synced between collab participants!!
 All communication and shared assets are encrypted so people outside the collab will have no access.
 It's a lot of fun!!!


Please give it a try with your friends first before purchasing (up to 10 minutes per collab session without the DLC)


For more info on how to use VNet, see here: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Multiplayer

That page also has all the security details.

AND AGAIN, massive thanks to all beta testers!!!!!

The following minor changes/improvements were also made:


 Bugfix: Updated libdshowcapture to blacklist broken virtual webcams. This should prevent VTS from crashing during loading. Thanks Emiliana for the fix!!
 Bugfix: Updated the DLL name for the virtual webcam used by VTS. This is required because OBS will soon start blocking some broken virtual webcam DLLs by name.
 Improvement: Auto-hide circle buttons (main menu) after a few seconds when nothing is clicked so people don’t accidentally leave that open during streams.



For a full list, see: https://trello.com/c/wQoOxGDY
And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.24.0
notes.content:
It's been a while! The next big update is unfortunately taking a bit longer than expected, but it will be done soon... In the meantime:

This update implements the following changes:


 Added support for Spout2 capture (fast, transparent video, doesn't capture UI). Windows only. This is now the recommended capture method on Windows.
 Temporarily disabled downloading Live2D Models and Live2D Items from the Steam Workshop. This will be enabled again ASAP. Sorry for the inconvenience. 



For more info on how to set up and use Spout2, see here: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Recording-Streaming-with-OBS

The following minor changes/improvements were also made:


 Own (non-shared) BTTV emotes now work with Twitch Emote Dropper
 You can now deactivate the “Double-tap screen to show menu” overlay by deactivating the “Show controls” toggle.
 Fixed security issue during Twitch authentication. Thanks @zemnmez for reporting this!
 Item scene hotkeys would fail to properly load the items if the name of the VTube Studio model is changed. This is now fixed.
 Various other small bugfixes.



For a full list, see: https://trello.com/c/uvoGclYQ

And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.23.5
notes.content:
Small update that fixes a bug and adds two new features.

The fixed bug is a bug that was introduced in the last update where sometimes Live2D Items would load big/incorrectly/broken behind the model and could not be deleted without restarting VTube Studio.

New feature 1

You can now set your models to remember active Expressions. Only Expressions from hotkeys that don't have an auto-deactivate-timeout are remembered.

This means that when you reload the model or restart VTube Studio, the active expressions will stay on. This also works with Live2D Items if they are created based on a VTS model that has this setting active.

https://i.imgur.com/loWQgdt.png

New feature 2

All physics customization now also works in Live2D Items. That means you can customize per-physics-group wind strength, physics strength and dragging physics strength. Just customize these values in your active model and then create a Live2D Item from it.

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.22.0
notes.content:
This update adds the new NVIDIA Broadcast Tracker to VTube Studio (requires RTX GPU), which provides high-quality and performant webcam tracking.

To use it, download the free DLC here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2178540/VTube_Studio__NVIDIA_Broadcast_Tracker/

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.21.5
notes.content:

 Big API changes for plugin developers: Plugins can now load/move/animate/etc. items in the scene, including Live2D items.
 Another API change: It is now possible for tracking-type plugins (like VBridger) and throwing-type plugins (like T.I.T.S) to work together. This is a change that these plugins will have to implement on their side as well though, so please give them some time.
 Button to reset all VTS settings or just "do not show again" choices.
 Option to load random item from item scene instead of all items in scene for "Item Scene" hotkeys.

 Better drag-handling for multiple overlayed Live2D items.
 Fixed bug that incorrectly caused "mask limit exceeded" warning to be shown.


For a full list, see: https://trello.com/c/SXwdC9tG

And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.20.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39552646/72aad18e253ae9028f486937c1c18d2cb01b28cd.png

IMPORTANT: Do not re-color your model without permission of your artist!!

You can now use hotkeys to load ArtMesh screen/multiply color presets.

To do that, prepare your model with the ArtMesh colors you want to register, then create a new hotkey of type "ArtMesh Color Preset". Use the "Record Settings" button on the hotkey UI to record the current settings. This hotkey can then be used to load/unload that screen/multiply color preset.

You can also create a hotkey of that type with empty settings to create a hotkey that removes the currently loaded color preset for that model.

For more info, see: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Live2D-Items

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.18.0
notes.content:

 Functionality to record animations in VTube Studio. Animations can be played directly in VTube Studio or re-imported into Live2D Cubism.
 Option to "Load model at its position when it was last unloaded" for "Load Model" hotkeys.

More info about animation recording: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Record-Animations
More info about copying model configs: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Copy-config-between-models

For a full list, see: https://trello.com/c/gR1uw2uv

And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.16.2
notes.content: Fixed an issue that caused the app to freeze for some users when starting it on macOS.

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.16.0
notes.content:
This update implements the following changes:


 In-app Live2D expression editor. You no longer have to use the Live2D Viewer to create expressions.
 Replaced Android tracker (ARCore) with a new tracker that's more precise (Mocap4Face by Alter). This tracker supports eye tracking, blink tracking, mouthX-tracking and tongue tracking. It has some issues with Mouth-Open tracking and Wink-Tracking, but it's under active development so that's likely to improve.
 Added MouthX and Tongue-Tracking to Auto-setup. If you use the Live2D parameter IDs "ParamMouthX" and "ParamTongue", the auto-setup will be able to find them and set them up correctly. Alternative parameter IDs for them are "PARAM_MOUTH_X" and "PARAM_TONGUE".


The following minor changes/improvements were also made:


 Fix for lag issues in some games. Start VTS as admin and it will automatically try to request GPU priority. How to start VTS as admin: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Starting-as-Admin



For a full list, see: https://trello.com/c/nkUBfE4P

And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.15.8
notes.content:
This update implements the following changes:


 Added indicator that shows which model is currently loaded in the model selection bar (useful if you have multiple versions of the same model and you're too lazy to change the name).
 "Reload Microphone" hotkeys now have an option to toggle the microphone on/off instead with the hotkey.
 There are now button on model config UI items and hotkey config UI items to minimize/maximize them.
 You can now press the ALT key while scrolling to rotate/scale items or the model slower.



The following improvements and bugfixes were also made:


 FPS value is now saved correctly for animated items in item scenes.
 Item scenes with an empty item group now aren't deactivated if another item scene with an empty item group is activated.
 Items can now be re-added to an item scene after they have been removed once from it.
 Minimum size limit for items has been decreased so you can make items smaller.
 Item and model scaling is now more "linear", meaning it doesn't get "faster" the smaller the item/model becomes.
 Hand pose "Hand Tracked" now works for left hand too (was only working for right hand before).


For a full list, see: https://trello.com/c/KjdaVZIO

And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.14.7
notes.content:
This update implements the following changes:


 Second idle animation that is automatically activated when the tracking is lost. Can take over all parameters.
 Remember scale/position/rotation and pin state for items when app is restarted or model is unloaded and loaded again.
 Thumbnails for item system.
 Button in item list to remove all items from scene and a hotkey to do the same.
 Button to send the currently loaded model to the connected phone with one click.
 Functionality to set physics FPS independently of app render FPS.
 You can now flip items by [CTRL] + Clicking them.



The following minor changes/improvements were also made:


 Unlocked webcam FPS (higher than 24 is now possible) if your CPU can handle it.
 New VSync option: "1/2 Screen Refresh Rate". May be good for 120 FPS screens.
 Live2D parameter name is shown in list now instead of ID if available.
 Files with incorrect capitalization load on iOS/Android now.
 MacOS: Fixed a few crashes related to OVRLipsync.
 Auto-setup for hand parameters now works correctly if you use the right parameter names (see Wiki documentation page, https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Hand-Tracking).
 Hand-tracking is now enabled on MacOS (experimental!)



For a full list, see: https://trello.com/c/RLy9a6zT

And if you have questions, as always, please ask in the Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.12.0
notes.content:
This update adds the following new functionality:


 "Scene lighting overlay". You can select a screen or window, VTS will calculate the average color and use that color as overlay for your model. This will make it seem like the model is in the game/video/etc. Can also be controlled using hotkeys: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Display-Light-Overlay
 Added functionality to send iOS blendshape tracking data directly to VSeeFace: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Sending-data-to-VSeeFace
 Fixed NDI crash/glitch bugs and re-enabled NDI autostart.
 Added NDI 5 support including support for multiple NDI streams with multiple VTube Studio instances.
 Support for landscape mode tracking (Android/iOS). The UI doesn't rotate on the smartphone, but axis are now automatically switched after rotating the phone, so the tracking will work correctly even in landscape mode (after calibrating).


And also check out the Trello to see everything included in this release: https://trello.com/c/yC0X5E9P

If you have any questions, check out the VTube Studio Discord: https://discord.gg/VTubeStudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.11.0
notes.content:
This update fixes various bugs and adds the following new functionality:


 Plugin functionality. Plugins allow stuff like Twitch integration and more, see https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Plugins
 Using one webcam or iPhone/Android device to control multiple models. For details, see: https://github.com/DenchiSoft/VTubeStudio/wiki/Controlling-multiple-models-with-one-Webcam-or-iPhone-Android-device
 Community localization: Added languages like Traditional and Simplified Chinese
 ...


For more details, see https://twitter.com/VTubeStudio/status/1439719246842540039

And also check out the Trello to see everything included in this release: https://trello.com/c/5LD43lBP

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.9.14
notes.content:
Item hotkeys and the VTube Studio API are not quite done yet, so here's a small update in between!
The full list of changes can be found here: https://trello.com/c/bwrFnDhd

Update content:


 Drag & Drop support for items. Just drag items (PNG/JPG/GIF/...) into the VTS window to load them into the scene without revealing the VTS interface on stream.
 Support for GIF items.
 Smoothing for items to make them track your model more loosely/smoothly.
 Search box for models.
 Auto-start for: USB, Virtual Webcam and NDI.
 General VTS config is now saved into a text file (JSON) you can backup, modify, etc.
 Select things in lists in VTS per double-click instead of clicking "Select" every time.
 ...and more!!


The documentation has also been updated: https://denchisoft.com/documentation/

As always, if there are any issues with this release, please bring them up right away in the VTube Studio Discord: https://discord.gg/vtubestudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.8.5
notes.content:
This update includes a few bugfixes and various improvements and new features. The full list can be found here: https://trello.com/c/7378CIPj

Update content:


 USB Connection (instead of WiFi) between iOS and Mac/PC.
 New parameter for iOS: MouthX, tracks left/right shift of mouth.
 New lipysnc parameter: MouthSmilePlusVoiceFrequency.
 Functionality for setting exact window resolution.
 Configurable fade time for movement hotkeys (e.g. "instant" movement).
 Access to VTube Studio files directly using the "Files" app on iOS. Allows you to easily copy in items/models/etc. using iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, ... instead of always having to use iTunes.
 Tracking sensitivity settings on iOS and Android
 ...and more!!


The documentation has also been updated: https://denchisoft.com/documentation/

As always, if there are any issues with this release, please bring them up right away in the VTube Studio Discord: https://discord.gg/vtubestudio

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.7.2
notes.content:
VTube Studio 1.7.2 is now live. This small patch fixes some behavior that was broken in 1.7.1.


 When loading models per hotkey, the loaded model will now appear at the same position as the old model.
 Fixed bug where the mouth doesn't open all the way when the Mouth Open Sensitivity is lowered.
 Added better Virtual Webcam installation script.
 Fixed some issues in "deactivate after X seconds" and "deactivate on key up" expressions.

notes.title: VTube Studio 1.7.0
notes.content:
VTube Studio 1.7.0 is now live! It comes with a whole bunch of big and small bugfixes, some new features and webcam tracking improvements.

For a full list, see https://trello.com/c/2KY7P73H

A few highlights:


 You can now start VTube Studio without steam. Use the "start_without_steam.bat" file next to the main .exe
 New tracking option: "Manual" mode, doesn't require tracking warmup. This is the new default, so you have to deactivate it if you want to go back to the previous mode.
 Tracking sensitivity options for mouth, eyes, blinking, etc.
 New animation option: Animations that stop on the last frame.
 New animation/expression options: Configurable fade time and auto-deactivate after X seconds.
 New expression options: Deactivate expression when key is let go.
 UI and general performance improvements.
 ...many more!!


If there are any issues, please let us know on Discord right away.

https://discord.gg/vtubestudio
